items.title: Search-G1: Co-Evolving Representation-Based Rewards for Selective Grounded Search
items.title_zh: Search-G1：面向选择性有据搜索的协同演化表示奖励
items.summary: Search-G1 is a reward framework for search-augmented agents that couples retrieval necessity with evidence reliance using two intervention-calibrated hidden-state readouts: a prompt readout for closed-book sufficiency and an answer-commit readout for sensitivity to evidence deletion. Across four QA benchmarks and two model scales it reports competitive task accuracy with stronger counterfactual evidence dependence and fewer searches in the main comparisons, without process annotations or LLM-judge inference.

items.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
items.title_zh: FlashRT：引导智能体部署实时多模态应用的智能体框架
items.summary: FlashRT is an agent harness that guides coding agents through a chain-of-program process: translating a reference implementation into an IR, validating it with a sequential interpreter, and iteratively benchmarking candidate transformations to build multi-GPU deployments. It reports up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200, and on AMD MI355X cuts Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio latency by 65% versus the expert vLLM-Omni implementation.

items.title: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: 假先知：论智能体系统中世界模型的安全性
items.summary: The paper identifies security vulnerabilities specific to learned world models used by LLM agents, showing that attackers can induce mispredictions in terminal-based agent pipelines with up to 95% success, potentially causing unintended command execution, denial of service, wallet drainage and private-information extraction. It introduces a security benchmark dataset for text-based world models and offers practical recommendations for hardening agentic systems.

items.title: ZenGen: Social Mind for LLMs
items.title_zh: ZenGen：面向大语言模型的社会心智
items.summary: ZenGen is an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing and grounding social intelligence in LLMs. It introduces SoMBench, a 3,481-instance psychology-grounded benchmark on which the best of 20 evaluated models reaches only 72.08%, and pairs a diagnosis-driven training recipe with Actio, a harness that routes procedural guidance, mental-state representations, reusable experience and gated RAG into inference.

items.title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
items.title_zh: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents：原生 Python 面向对象智能体
items.summary: NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA) is a model-agnostic Python framework in which an agent is a Python object: methods are the actions, fields are state, docstrings are prompts and type annotations are contracts, with `...` method bodies completed at runtime by an LLM-driven loop. It combines six model-facing ideas on one surface and is demonstrated on SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0 and ARC-AGI-3.

items.title: AHEAD: Advancing Multi-Class Label Aggregation with Interpretable Cross-Annotator Modeling
items.title_zh: AHEAD：面向多分类标签聚合的可解释跨标注者建模
items.summary: AHEAD learns cross-annotator contexts with a graph neural network and decodes them into interpretable annotator-specific confusion matrices to aggregate noisy multi-class crowdsourced labels. On 10 real-world datasets it raises average label accuracy from 68.75% to 73.23%, with a best-case gain of 14.9%.

items.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
items.title_zh: 面向智能电网的大语言模型与智能体系统：架构与应用教程
items.summary: This tutorial reviews prompting strategies and agentic architectures for smart-grid LLM systems and proposes a solver-grounded principle: report a numerical result only when it comes from a trusted tool and passes explicit verification. EVAgent reproduces the CVXPY optimum while cutting LLM-only unmet energy by 7.5–9.5x, and GridDebugAgent repairs 17/39 contingency cases while reducing violations by 52.3%.

items.title: Copy Less, Ground More: Overcoming Repetitive Copying in Long-Context Reasoning via Evidence-Aware Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 少抄多锚定：用证据感知强化学习克服长上下文推理中的重复复制
items.summary: The authors identify repetitive copying — models copying prompt text into reasoning traces instead of solving the task — as a pervasive long-context failure that intensifies with context length and traces it to insufficient grounding in key evidence. Their GEAR reward shaping adds a grounding reward for overlap with key evidence and a distractor penalty, improving results by up to 4.6 average points over accuracy-only RL while reducing copying and thinking length.

items.title: Tool-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Repair for Securing LLM-Generated C Code
items.title_zh: 工具引导的检索增强修复：保障 LLM 生成的 C 代码安全
items.summary: The work combines compilation diagnostics, CodeQL static analysis and KLEE symbolic execution with retrieval of prior repair patterns to iteratively repair LLM-generated C code. On 5,000 embedded-relevant C tasks it cuts CodeLlama 7B's security defect rate from 49% to 19% and CodeQL errors by 83.7%, and reduces DeepSeek Coder 1.3B compilation failures from 42% to 22%.

items.title: IssueTrojanBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents Against Malicious Issue Requests
items.title_zh: IssueTrojanBench：评测 AI 编码智能体抵御恶意 Issue 请求的能力
items.summary: IssueTrojanBench evaluates Cursor, Claude Code and Codex Desktop, backed by GPT-5.3 Codex/GPT-5.4 and Sonnet 4.6, against malicious issue requests built from four attack categories, six delivery vectors and perturbations. 66.5% of the malicious issues penetrated all agent- and LLM-level guardrails, rejection came almost entirely from the LLMs rather than the agent frameworks, and current agent-level defenses offered limited extra protection.

items.title: PyroDash: Cost-Efficient Token-Level Small-Large Language Model Collaborative Inference
items.title_zh: PyroDash：成本高效的 token 级小模型-大模型协同推理
items.summary: PyroDash trains a small model to emit a control token when it needs help, handing the query and partial reasoning trace to a frozen LLM in a single handoff, with a cost-aware GRPO reward balancing accuracy against inference cost. Across five math reasoning benchmarks it reports 64.04% average accuracy at 20.4% lower cost with λ=0.05, and 54.55% accuracy at a 1.90% LLM token ratio with λ=0.6.

items.title: MosaicJoin: Compact Semantic Sketches for Value-Level Join Discovery
items.title_zh: MosaicJoin：面向值级连接发现的紧凑语义草图
items.summary: MosaicJoin is a value-level semantic join discovery method that uses compact sketches to approximate whether two columns are joinable without comparing every value, plus query subsampling with provable accuracy guarantees. It requires no training, handles query columns of up to 57K values and data-lake columns of up to 1M values, and runs up to 66 times faster than other value-level methods across the benchmarks tested.

items.title: Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
items.title_zh: 基于证据推理的智能体根因分析
items.summary: AgentRCA is a zero-shot agentic framework for root cause analysis that combines a data-driven digital twin modeling normal system dynamics with a tool-augmented LLM that iteratively gathers statistical evidence and evaluates competing hypotheses. On a real multiphase-flow facility and a large chemical plant it matched fully supervised baselines without fault-specific training and produced transparent reasoning traces linking observed symptoms to physical causes.

items.title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
items.title_zh: 并非所有大模型推理都能在思维链中看到
items.summary: The authors show that frontier models can use semantically irrelevant filler tokens to improve accuracy on synthetic reasoning tasks, with gains of up to 13 percentage points across 13 models. Filler tokens also let Claude Opus 4.5 satisfy a hidden modular arithmetic constraint without losing primary-task accuracy, indicating consequential computation with no interpretable trace in output tokens.

items.title: An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.title_zh: 面向机器学习原子间势的本体
items.summary: The paper presents the MLIPs ontology, an OWL 2 DL ontology organized into Method, Training Data and Benchmark modules that describes machine-learning interatomic potential methods, their hyperparameters, DFT-provenance training datasets and published benchmarks. It connects materials-science and machine-learning ontologies, declares 27 formal axioms enforcing data completeness and consistency, and is evaluated through competency questions over a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph and OWL reasoning.

items.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
items.title_zh: ACM：面向长程任务的智能体上下文管理
items.summary: ACM is a framework that gives agents purpose-built context-editing tools so they can decide when to compress their context, offload discarded content to an external memory system and query it later on demand. The authors also build a post-training pipeline from demonstrations of context management and report gains on agentic search and coding tasks, with code and checkpoints released.

items.title: Aethel: A Reproducible Graph-Retrieval Framework for Multi-Hop Financial Diligence
items.title_zh: Aethel：面向多跳金融尽职调查的可复现图检索框架
items.summary: Aethel combines bipartite Personalized PageRank graph retrieval, a coreference-aware teleportation layer and specialist agents to answer multi-hop questions over fragmented financial disclosures. It reports HR@5 of 100.0% on 2WikiMultiHopQA and 88.5% on MuSiQue, but on a 4,123-chunk financial corpus graph retrieval does not surpass a strong BM25 baseline at open-corpus scale.

items.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
items.title_zh: SWE-Pruner Pro：代码大模型早已知道该剪掉什么
items.summary: SWE-Pruner Pro prunes tool outputs inside a coding agent by turning the agent's own internal representations into per-line keep-or-prune labels, using a small head and a length-aware embedding keyed to each output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks it saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving quality, and on MiMo-V2-Flash raises SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by 3.8%.

items.title: Graph-Based Agentic AI with LangGraph: Workflow Pathways for Long-Running Stateful Business Processes
items.title_zh: 基于 LangGraph 的图式智能体：长时运行有状态业务流程的工作流路径
items.summary: This practitioner guide presents three executable LangGraph recipes — SQL analytics with repair loops, agentic RAG with evidence gating, and human-in-the-loop policy review with interrupt and checkpoint recovery — showing how typed state, conditional routing, retries and traces fit together. It positions LangGraph by workflow complexity rather than as a universal default, noting that simpler ReAct loops, schema-first tools or DSPy may fit other cases.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型中超网络知识注入的缩放规律
items.summary: The authors train a hypernetwork to generate a fixed LoRA adapter that injects a large corpus of facts into a target model, decoupling injection capacity from the model's general capability. Using MegaWikiQA, tens of millions of multi-hop examples across 39 domains from Wikidata5M, they find power-law scaling along depth, width and target size, with reliable out-of-distribution generalization and steeper scaling exponents than LoRA or full fine-tuning.

items.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Symbolic Security Protocol Analysis
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在符号化安全协议分析中的表现
items.summary: The study tests GPT and DeepSeek in chat and reasoning modes on 130 obfuscated AnB/AnBx protocols covering 388 goals, scored against ProVerif and OFMC. Enabling reasoning lifts GPT's precision from 27.3% to 64.8% while recall stays at 54.5%, verdicts are unstable across runs, and self-reported confidence showed no meaningful correlation with correctness, so the authors see LLMs at best as pre-screening filters.

items.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing
items.title_zh: 泄密语言模型：通过逐 token 时序窃取架构与推理优化信息
items.summary: LeakyLMs infers proprietary model and deployment details from token-generation timing over remote APIs, detecting speculative decoding and the draft model's context length — measured for Gemini Flash 2.5 at roughly 128K tokens — and recovering transformer layer count, hidden dimension and attention heads. On Llama models the near-correct architecture appears in the top-10 guesses more than 90% of the time.

items.title: Benchmarking LLMs for Verilog Design Flows
items.title_zh: 面向 Verilog 设计流程的大语言模型基准评测
items.summary: The paper presents a reproducible benchmarking platform that evaluates open-source LLMs on 50 Verilog RTL generation tasks using constrained prompting, AST-based repair, formal equivalence verification, Verilator compilation and Icarus Verilog simulation. Across 1,610 runs on Llama-3-8B, StarCoder2-7B and TinyLlama-1.1B, the pipeline raised average syntax validity from 0% to 70.43% and simulation pass rate to 51.8%, with TinyLlama reaching 80.0% syntax validity.

items.title: RUMBA: Russian User Memory Benchmark
items.title_zh: RUMBA：俄语用户长期记忆基准
items.summary: RUMBA is a long-term conversational memory benchmark built from timestamped user-assistant dialogues, with a fine-grained taxonomy covering semantic type, session scope, temporal reasoning and explicitness of temporal expressions. It is designed for Russian with an aligned English subset, and is used to diagnose memory systems and long-context models across benchmark slices and identify their strengths and failure modes.

items.title: ToolGuardian: Declarative Security for AI Agent-Tool Interactions
items.title_zh: ToolGuardian：面向 AI 智能体-工具交互的声明式安全
items.summary: ToolGuardian is a policy-driven framework that vets third-party agent tools before admission and authorizes them at runtime using progressive characterization from descriptions, system-call traces, mock execution and source analysis. An Answer Set Programming policy layer reached 0.86 deny-class F1 and 88% accuracy on 16 MCP-style tools, including 8 malicious variants, and fully specified runtime realizations classified all 20 scenarios correctly.

items.title: Language-Routed RAG and Direct Option Scoring for Multilingual Financial QA: DS@GT at FinMMEval
items.title_zh: 语言路由 RAG 与直接选项打分：DS@GT 的多语言金融问答方案
items.summary: DS@GT's FinMMEval 2026 submission builds a LangGraph RAG pipeline that detects query language, retrieves from a 30,209-entry multilingual knowledge base using BGE-M3 embeddings and FAISS, and scores candidate option letters via next-token log-probabilities. It routes among Qwen3-14B, Qwen2.5-14B and Llama-3.1-8B by language, and reports that chain-of-thought prompting cut Greek accuracy from 90.7% to 20.9% while Qwen3's default thinking mode collapsed Arabic scoring to near chance.

items.title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
items.title_zh: AgentOmnia：面向全场景应用的智能体模型扩展
items.summary: AgentOmnia is a full-scenario agentic scaling framework that coordinates a Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy with environment-task synthesis, post-training, evaluation and PRD-guided improvement, constructing 5,018 stateful environments, 255,375 tools and 52,361 tasks. Starting from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, it raises the OmniaBench challenging-subset pass rate from 9.16% to 37.11% and the four-benchmark macro-average from 22.86% to 41.69%, surpassing Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on all four benchmarks.

items.title: Confidently Wrong: Exception Chain Collapse in Frontier LLM Rule Evaluation
items.title_zh: 自信地犯错：前沿大模型规则评估中的异常链崩塌
items.summary: The paper documents exception chain collapse, a failure in eligibility evaluation under nested conditional rules, and notes that some failure cells silently closed under the same model alias between March and April 2026. It presents the Aethis Eligibility Module, a neuro-symbolic architecture in which LLMs author rules and an SMT-based layer executes them deterministically, reporting higher accuracy than frontier models on LegalBench tasks.

items.title: RareLens: Towards End-to-End Rare Disease Care via Aligning Divergent Large Language Model Reasoning
items.title_zh: RareLens：通过对齐发散的大模型推理实现端到端罕见病诊疗
items.summary: RareLens reconciles divergent reasoning trajectories from multiple heterogeneous LLMs into decisions across risk screening, diagnosis, treatment planning and prognosis prediction, built on RarelensBench with 157,525 real-world cases spanning 33 Orphanet categories. It outperformed GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Gemini-2.5-Pro across all stages, reaching 0.917 AUC for screening and top-1 accuracies of 65.5% and 89.8% for diagnosis and treatment, and in an external evaluation of 1,287 cases with 23 physicians both autonomous and assisted RareLens outperformed unaided physicians.

items.title: A Frozen 12B Beats Frontier Models on Verified Work: 100% Accuracy, 0 Tokens, Bit-Exact, Forever
items.title_zh: 冻结的12B模型在已验证任务上胜过前沿模型：100%准确、零Token、位精确且永久一致
items.summary: The report describes a frozen 12B model paired with a persistent memory of verified solutions, claiming 180/180 correct answers at zero generation tokens across nine problem families and four model architectures. It reports that exact addressing makes zero errors where approximate similarity retrieval selects the wrong item 94.3% of the time, and that the store supports a 6,000,000-token movable window on a single 46 GB GPU.

items.title: Melo: A Production LLM-Powered Music Recommendation Agent
items.title_zh: Melo：生产环境中的LLM驱动音乐推荐智能体
items.summary: Melo is an LLM-powered music recommendation agent deployed on NetEase Cloud Music as a deterministic five-node state graph over heterogeneous tools. It adds inference-time entity grounding and reflective retry to handle entity hallucination and long-tail degradation; a one-month A/B test reports an over 2 pp lift in a primary playlist retention metric.

items.title: AstrBotDevs/AstrBot
items.title_zh: AstrBot：集成多平台的开源 AI 智能体助手与开发框架
items.summary: AstrBot is an open-source AI agent assistant and development framework that integrates multiple IM platforms, LLMs and plugins, positioned as an openclaw alternative and written in Python.

items.title: deerwork-ai/deer-workflow
items.title_zh: deerwork-ai/deer-workflow：开源图工程运行时
items.summary: An open-source graph engineering runtime that keeps orchestration in TypeScript while delegating semantic work to replaceable agent runtimes.

items.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
items.title_zh: 长时程模型时代的安全与对齐
items.summary: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, pointing to new safety risks and observed failures as well as safeguards that improved through iterative deployment.

items.title: Kimi K3 Is Competitive with Fable; Kimi K3 and Fable Is SoTA
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 与 Fable 旗鼓相当，二者同达 SoTA
items.summary: Fireworks AI reports that Kimi K3 is competitive with Fable, noting that Kimi K3 ranks second only to Fable 5 on the AA-Briefcase benchmark.

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 合作应对模型评估期间的安全事件
items.summary: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident that occurred during AI model evaluation, describing advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.

items.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
items.title_zh: OpenAI Presence 正式发布
items.summary: OpenAI introduces Presence, an enterprise AI agent platform for deploying voice and chat agents in customer and internal workflows, described as proven.

items.title: Teaching LLMs to Update Beliefs for Efficient Long-Horizon Interaction
items.title_zh: 教LLM更新信念，实现高效长程交互
items.summary: BAIR researchers introduce ABBEL, a framework that replaces an agent's full interaction history with supervised natural-language belief states. It aims to keep long-horizon contexts concise and interpretable without the performance cost of recursive summarization, which the post says is especially severe in human-assistance domains such as collaborative code generation.

items.title: Kimi K3 Investment Research Capability Benchmarked: Moonshot AI Top Model Now Powers AlphaEngine With First-Tier IRB Scores
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 投资研究能力基准测试：Moonshot AI 顶级模型驱动 AlphaEngine 并取得一线 IRB 成绩
items.summary: AlphaEngine evaluated Kimi K3 on its proprietary IRB investment research benchmark and reports that K3 beats GPT-5.5 and OPUS-4.8 on temporal judgment, evidence boundary control and premise correction; the model is already deployed.

items.title: Building AI That Works: ESnet's Pragmatic Approach to AI-Driven Operational Excellence
items.title_zh: 构建真正可用的 AI：ESnet 以务实方式实现 AI 驱动的运营卓越
items.summary: ESnet's ORBIT project embeds an agentic AI system in ServiceNow for network operations, using a centralized reasoning hub, MCP tool access, a semantic search layer and an operator chat interface, with task logic packaged as versioned, tested skills. It delivered all six initial tasks, enabled two additional tasks proposed by NOC engineers, and the skills approach reduced task completion steps while eliminating observed error modes.
